title: Protocol
description: Everything that crosses the plugin ↔ daemon boundary, for schema export.

Event.description:
A single immutable fact in a run's log, as stored by the daemon.

`seq`, `recorded_at`, `device_id`, `prev_hash` and `hash` are assigned by
the daemon at append time; clients only supply `event_id` (their
idempotency key), `occurred_at` and `payload`.

seq.description: Position in the run's log, starting at 1. Gapless.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened according to the client clock.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in this run; `None` only for `seq == 1`.

hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of this event without `hash` or `sig`.

sig.description:
Ed25519 signature over the `hash` (hex), from the key that signs this
device's chain at this point. Required: an unsigned event fails verification.

project_root.description:
A local path, so never written by this build: the daemon keeps a
run's root outside the log, which is published verbatim. Read only
so that older logs still load; a run whose log holds one cannot be
published.

device_pubkey.description: Hex ed25519 public key of the device that signs this chain.

start_head.description: The project's git HEAD when the run started.

ruleset_digest.description: sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the category the run pinned.

disclosure_commitment.description:
sha256 (hex) of the run's disclosure key, which stays on the device
until the run is revealed.

oneOf.description:
A prompt, without its text. The text is kept outside the chain, keyed
by `event_id`, so deleting it never breaks the log.

host.description: Which tool the prompt came from, e.g. `claude-code`, `opencode`.

content_digest.description:
HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the redacted text under the device's prompt
key, which never leaves the machine.

length.description: Length of the redacted text, in characters.

redacted.description: True when secret redaction changed the text.

key.description: Stable key for category milestones, e.g. `happy-path-demo`.

required_trust.description: Replaces the trust the proposal required, raising or lowering it.

claimant.description:
Who made the claim. Set by the daemon from the token the request
carried; a value sent by the client is overwritten.

oneOf.description:
The user confirms an agent's claim on a milestone whose rules require
the user's word (`required_trust` `self_declared`). Only the full
token may send it.

The first event of a device's chain in a run it did not start: names
the key that signs that chain.

The device's signing key changed. Signed by the new key; `certificate`
is the old key's signature over the new public key, so the chain
stays verifiable from public keys alone.
Comes from the run's category ruleset.
Proposed by an agent; must be accepted by the user before it counts.

Trust.description: How much a milestone claim can be believed. Ordered weakest → strongest.

Claimant.description: Who claimed a milestone, by the token the claim arrived with.

oneOf.description: The full token: the user, or a command the user ran.
The agent token (`$DATA_DIR/agent-token`), held by agent tools.
The user reset; the next prompt starts a fresh run.

AppendRequest.description: Append one event to an existing run.

event_id.description: Client idempotency key. Retrying with the same id is a no-op.

ProjectAppendRequest.description:
Append one event to whichever run is active for a project. Lets clients
write (and spool while offline) without knowing the run id.

inserted.description: False when the event_id already existed.

derived.description: Events the daemon appended as a consequence (verification, completion).

verification.description: Result of checking attached evidence, when there was any to check.

VerificationReport.description:
What the daemon's verifiers concluded about a claim's evidence. A failed
check is not recorded in the log: the claim keeps the trust it was made
with, and claiming again re-runs the checks.

verifier.description: Verifiers that passed, joined with `+` (e.g. `git+url`), when verified.

VerificationFact.description: Only facts actually checked by the observer; these do not assert product semantics.

PromptRequest.description: Record a prompt for a project, starting a run if none is active.

category_id.description: Category for a run started by this prompt.

category_version.description:
The category version the project pinned (`category_version` in
`.speedrun/project.json`). `None` takes the daemon's latest; a version
the daemon does not know is a 400 and starts no run.

starts_turn.description: Also mark an agent turn as started for this session.

run_started.description: True when this prompt started a new run.

closed.description: No further prompts go to this run: it was abandoned, or reset after completing.

timing.description: Clocks as of the `now` the view was folded at (or completion).

open_turns.description: Sessions with an agent turn in progress.

paused_since.description: Start of the current pause, if paused.

idle_since.description: Start of the current gap between agent turns, if the run is live, unpaused and no turn is open.

last_event_at.description: When the daemon recorded the latest event.

trust.description: Highest trust any claim or verification has reached.

counted_at.description: When the milestone first met its required trust. This is the split.

pending_confirmation.description:
An agent's claim holds this milestone and awaits the user's
`milestone_confirmed`; until then the milestone does not count.

Timing.description: Elapsed time measured several ways, all in milliseconds since run start.

wall_ms.description: Real time: wall clock since the first prompt.

agent_ms.description: Time at least one agent turn was running (union across sessions), minus pauses.

human_ms.description: Time between agent turns, each gap capped at the idle threshold, minus pauses.

Category.description:
A versioned ruleset. Runs pin `(id, version)` at start so later edits to
a category never change how an old run is judged.

milestones.description: The run completes when every one of these counts.

suggested_evidence.description: Evidence kinds that satisfy this milestone, as a hint to users and agents.

verification_policy.description: Explicit verification rule. Absent only in historical rulesets.

signed.description: Events carrying a verified device signature.

unsigned.description:
Events with no signature: schema v1 logs, or a chain that predates
signing on this device.

ExportResponse.description:
`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/export?tier=2`: what a tier 2 publication would
carry about the run's prompts. No prompt text.

disclosure_commitment.description: sha256 (hex) of the run's disclosure key, as in `RunStarted`.

prompts.description: One entry per prompt, in log order.

commitment.description:
HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the redacted prompt text under the run's
disclosure key.

length.description: Length of the redacted text, in characters.

RotateResponse.description: `POST /v1/device/rotate`: the device's signing key was replaced.

device_pubkey.description: The key that signs from now on (hex).

HealthResponse.description:
`GET /v1/health[?nonce=<hex>]`. Never carries a token. With a nonce, the
daemon proves it holds this data dir's token: `proof` is
`digest::token_proof(token, nonce)`, which a client checks before sending
a body, so a daemon serving another data dir is recognised, not trusted.

data_dir_id.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical path of the data dir the daemon serves.

pid.description: The daemon's process id, so `speedrun daemon stop` can wait for its exit.

proof.description: Present exactly when the request carried a nonce.

LiveSnapshot.description: Every live run worth showing, as of one instant.

protocol.description:
[`LIVE_PROTOCOL_VERSION`]: displays refuse a snapshot whose protocol
they do not know rather than misrender it.

as_of.description: The instant all `timing` values were computed at.

cursor.description:
Monotonic position in the daemon's whole log. Larger means newer;
ignore any snapshot whose cursor is lower than one already shown.

runs.description: Unfinished runs first, then most recently active.

LiveSource.description: The origin of a snapshot, so a display showing several can tell them apart.

project_name.description: Directory name of the project root, for display.

active_agents.description: Sessions with an agent turn in progress.

progress.description: Category milestones that count, out of all category milestones.

milestones.description: Category milestones first (in category order), then user and agent milestones.

pb.description: Best earlier completed run of the same category and version, by `timed_ms`.

errors.description:
Rows of this run's log that could not be decoded. Reported rather than
dropped; empty in a healthy log, and omitted from JSON then.

RunningClocks.description:
A clock that is running advances 1 ms per ms after `as_of`, except
`human`, which stops at `human_stops_at` (the idle cap).

counts.description: Reached at or above the required trust.

pb_split.description: The personal best's split for the same category milestone.

delta_ms.description: `split.timed_ms - pb_split.timed_ms`; negative is ahead of PB.

SnapshotError.description:
A stored event row the daemon could not decode while building a snapshot.
Carried on the run it belongs to so damage is visible, never silently gone.

event_id.description: The row's `event_id` column, known even when its body is truncated.
